SELECT p.*, s.name AS shop_name, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec AS material_spec, m.unit AS material_unit, m.retail_price FROM ch_wx_product p JOIN ch_wx_shop s ON s.id = p.shop_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id
p.shop_id = #{q.shopId} AND p.material_id IS NOT NULL AND p.material_id IS NULL AND p.removed = 0
AND (p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.sku_attrs LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.out_sku_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR p.sku_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY p.shop_id, p.product_id, p.id
